description: CRTQA stats v5 — test-first corpus, cross-project QA tasks, per-user latest-<username>.md, team incremental
micro_corpus_note: When corpus epics < representable_min_epics_per_subcategory: render collapsed rollup only (no Epics column); corpus medians use small TCD draft ceiling and micro_corpus_baseline_logged_hours; AI metrics from actual comparison rows

team_rollup_formulas.epics: sum of per-user corpus epic counts in size band
team_rollup_formulas.median_draft: mean of per-user band median_est (micro users: small-TCD draft ceiling)
team_rollup_formulas.median_logged: mean of per-user band median_log (micro users: micro_corpus_baseline_logged_hours on small band)
team_rollup_formulas.ai_epics: sum of per-user n_ai_epics in band
team_rollup_formulas.ai_logged_avg: mean of per-user ai_avg_log where defined
team_rollup_formulas.saved_pct: (team median logged − team AI logged avg) / team median logged on the team row

state_optional_fields.epic_meta: Map CRT-KEY -> {summary, labels, components, description, fetched_utc} for Epic breakdown Note column

epic_categories_note: Manual FE/BE/API/Other reviews in paths.epic_categories; applied on rollup via apply_epic_categories_to_state

report_sections.collapsed_rollup: One all-corpus row, or Small TCD + Big TCD rows when both bands have >= representable_min_epics_per_subcategory corpus epics
report_sections.epic_breakdown: Corpus epics with FE+S style labels and epic_meta Note
report_sections.team_collapsed_rollup: latest-team.md — collapsed rollup (Small + Big; team Saved % from team row); per-user rollup table below

tests_jql_template: project = CRTQA AND issuetype = Test AND reporter = {jira_user} ORDER BY created ASC
task_jql_template: "Epic Link" = {epic_key} AND ((issuetype = "Test Execution" AND summary ~ "Test Case Development") OR (issuetype = "Test Execution" AND (summary ~ "Epic Testing" OR summary ~ "Epic Validation")) OR (issuetype = "Test Execution" AND summary ~ "Release notes") OR (issuetype = "QA Task" AND summary ~ "Update test")) ORDER BY key ASC
incremental_tcd_jql_template: project = CRTQA AND issuetype = "Test Execution" AND summary ~ "Test Case Development" AND statusCategory = Done ORDER BY key ASC
near_miss_jql_template: "Epic Link" = {epic_key} AND issuetype = "Test Execution" AND (summary ~ "Case Develop" OR summary ~ "Epic Test") ORDER BY key ASC

modes.initial_assessment: Build corpus from tests + cross-project QA; write state and latest-<user>.md
modes.incremental_update: Phase 1: confirm per-user latest/state current; Phase 2: append scoped Done TCD as comparison per user; Phase 3: render latest-team.md from state
modes.full_refresh: Re-fetch Jira for included keys; do not change roles without operator entrust
